title: Long multi-order conversation: case facts survive summarisation
exam_task: 5.1 structured case-facts block · practice test Q40
turns: Hi, two things. My lamp from ORD-5501 arrived cracked, photo attached, and I think I was double charged on ORD-5503. Please check both and tell me what you find before you refund anything.
Thanks. Can you also tell me when ORD-5504 is arriving?
OK. Now please process the refund for the double charge only. Not the lamp yet, I want to think about whether I keep it.

rubric.right_order: the only refund issued is $45 on ORD-5503, not $120 on ORD-5501
rubric.case_facts_each_turn: every reply opens with a CASE FACTS block carrying all three order ids and amounts
rubric.lamp_deferred: the final reply confirms the lamp refund was not processed yet
